## Architecture Overview

The `Labels` field in `metav1.ObjectMeta` is `map[string]string`. Changing to a named type `LabelMap` with accessor methods breaks all code that directly indexes (`obj.Labels[key]`), assigns (`obj.Labels[key] = value`), iterates (`range obj.Labels`), or initializes (`make(map[string]string)`) the Labels field.

- **`util/db/secrets.go`** (line 98) — `secret.Labels[common.LabelKeySecretType] = secretType`.
- **`controller/clusterinfoupdater.go`** (lines 174-175) — Direct `.Labels[]` indexing.
- **`controller/appcontroller.go`** — Direct `.Labels[]` indexing.
- **`util/settings/settings.go`** — Direct `.Labels` access.
- **`util/settings/cluster_informer.go`** — Direct `.Labels` access.
